columns.name: id
columns.description: Surrogate primary key for the stored stock record.

columns.name: sku
columns.description: Addressing key part 1; NOT NULL per PI2, unique with location per PI1.

columns.name: location
columns.description: Addressing key part 2; NOT NULL per PI2, unique with sku per PI1.

columns.name: inventory_code
columns.description: Stored inventory classification code; NOT NULL per PI2.

columns.name: quantity
columns.description: Stored stock level; NOT NULL per PI2, constrained >= 0 per PI3.

columns.name: actor
columns.description: Actor who last filed/adjusted this record (NFR-F1-1 audit).

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: Immutable creation timestamp preserved across additive migrations (NFR-F1-1).

columns.name: updated_at
columns.description: Timestamp of the most recent write in the (sku, location) upsert.

schema_changes.detail: Create stock_records with id (uuid pk, gen_random_uuid()), sku/location/inventory_code/quantity NOT NULL, actor NOT NULL, created_at/updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL default now(); composite UNIQUE (sku, location); CHECK (quantity >= 0). The unique constraint is what lets the repository upsert a (sku, location) collision inside a single transaction rather than storing a duplicate row.
schema_changes.migration_note: Additive create-only migration with a working downgrade (DROP TABLE stock_records). No existing table is altered, so records created before this migration are preserved (PI5, NFR-F1-1). Reversible.
